client.name: Elaine Tan
client.background: Elaine Tan runs a family-owned distribution business and prefers straightforward explanations rather than investment jargon. She is familiar with pooled investments but less familiar with emerging-market debt.
client.investment_objective: She wants to broaden the sources of income in her investment portfolio and is prepared to hold an investment through market fluctuations rather than rely on it for immediate spending.
client.loss_attitude: She is hesitant about losses and feels uncomfortable when investment values fall. She can accept some investment loss, but her willingness is cautious rather than enthusiastic, and she worries that this caution could prevent her from proceeding.

setting.call_reason: Elaine has requested a short telephone appointment to discuss Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund and place an order if she is comfortable proceeding.
setting.conversation_style: A concise, courteous private-banking conversation in natural Singapore English. Elaine asks practical questions and becomes more tentative around potential losses; Marcus has a brisk, reassuring manner.

final_product.description: Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund is a pooled bond investment with exposure to debt issued in emerging markets. Its value and income depend on the performance of its underlying holdings.
concrete_risks: Emerging-market bond issuers may default or suffer credit deterioration, reducing the value of the fund's holdings.
Rising interest rates can depress the market prices of bonds held by the fund.
Political instability and thinner trading liquidity in emerging markets can cause sharp valuation changes and make underlying bonds harder to sell.
final_product.recommendation_basis: The fund's emerging-market debt exposure offers an additional source of bond income and issuer diversification, matching Elaine's interest in broadening portfolio income sources and her lack of an immediate spending need.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for telephone appointments
The client's plans to spend more time on personal interests
